label: last two copy-phase outputs (end of copy)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L), never on original tokens or <DEL>, and is concentrated on the final two outputs of the copy (to_go 0 or 1 carries ~84% of activation mass; activity decays to zero by to_go >= 6). Strongest activations are at L=3 on the last output (t=5, recall_idx 2); L=5 sequences fire rarely. Within the end-of-copy window it is token-gated and only ~25% of such steps are active: higher rate when the input (previous output) is m, i, o, b, h, x, e, but no small token set captures it (adding a token set raises precision to ~0.5 at the cost of recall). Does not fire on the first copy output (recall_idx 0).
